reason: Biocon's Pertuzumab biosimilar received a positive recommendation for EMA CHMP approval, indicating a significant step towards market access in Europe.
why_now: The EMA CHMP approval recommendation was announced on September 21, 2026, under a new tailored clinical approach.
source_headlines: Biocon Limited: Biocon Limited has informed the Exchange regarding a press release dated September 21, 2026, titled "Biocon s Pertuzumab Becomes First Biosimilar to Secure EMA CHMP Approval Recommendation Under New Tailored Clinical Approach".
